name: Ryoujoku Sister Kyoukai
source:
One morning main character wakes up after a bloody nightmare that has to do with his father who was theological lecturer. This evil impulse pushes him to insult girls. What's the truth behind his father's past?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一天早晨，主人公从一场与他当过神学讲师的父亲有关的血腥噩梦中醒来。这股邪恶的冲动驱使他去凌辱女孩们。他父亲的过去究竟隐藏着什么真相？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
